source: The purpose of this communication is to provide an overview of the umbrella borrowing process. Individuals wishing to participate in umbrella borrowing should undertake the selection of an umbrella from the stand situated adjacent to the reception desk. Upon completion of use, a return action should be carried out by placing the umbrella in the tray marked WET. This arrangement enables the facilitation of drying before subsequent borrowing. No payment is required. The umbrellas should remain within the building grounds.
